title: Client-Signed Commitments on Professional Services Projects
content:
In Professional Services Projects, signing a statement of work, change orders, termination notices, acceptance sign-off and acceptance rejections are the client's own commitments.

## How these commitments are registered

The former clause under which the service desk registered each of these as a change request carrying the change order number, type, value change and new target date, pending the authorized contact's e-signature, and never signed on the client's behalf, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for how client-signed commitments are registered and signed.

## Identity of the person signing

A contract change may be registered only for the client's authorized contact after identity verification has passed. This is read from the system record of the client's identity verification, before the change is registered; the change is tied to that client.

| Caller is the client's authorized contact? | Identity verification passed? | Contract change may be registered |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | yes |
| Yes | No | no |
| No | any | no |

Hypothetical illustration: an office manager who is not the authorized contact asks for a termination notice on an engagement; under this clause no contract change is registered for that caller.

superseded_clauses: the service desk registers each as a change request carrying the change order number, type, value delta and new target date, pending the authorized contact's e-signature, and never signs on the client's behalf.
